summary: Operator site live (phone, no posted rate: 'Daily / Weekly / Monthly Rates Available', call for availability, cash/check). Confirmed full hookups, city water, pull-throughs, no tents. Camper reports put the night at $25 (RV Life 2026, Campendium 8/8/25), but the operator has a page, so no fee written. Long-stay character is mixed; flags give the evidence.
flags: GATE FACTS (private): posted rate NONE on the operator's site ('Daily / Weekly / Monthly Rates Available', 'Call for availability – 402-690-4266', 'We accept payment in cash or check only'). No booking engine. Camper reports: $25 a night on all 5 RV Life reviews (stays 8/2026, 9/2026 x3, 10/2026); Campendium 'Last Nightly Rate $25, Reported 8/8/25'; a Google review from about 2 years ago: 'It's only $25/night Or cheaper by the week or month.' Well under $50, so no gateway needed. RV Life tier $$ (avg rate 24). Good Sam: not checked; none stated by the operator.

RATINGS: Google 4.2 (189 reviews); Campendium 4.0 (16); RV Life 4 stars (5 reviews in its API). None under 4.0 with 25+ reviews. Two of the newest Google reviews are hostile to the owner: 2 months ago 'Absolutely miserable experience ... The owner was rude, cranky'; 3 months ago 'The owner is rude and a bit hard to deal with. Every one in the park we talked to had had at least one issue if not more with her!' The newest (2 weeks ago) and the RV Life reviews praise the host ('Sandy was so sweet and accommodating').

LONG-STAY (mixed; I read it as a working transient park with a long-stay share, not mostly seasonal): for long-stay: weekly and monthly rates, winter rules ('Water hoses must have heat tape/insulation for temperatures 32 degrees and below', 'A maximum of one heat lamp under camper allowed', 'No hay or straw under campers/motor homes allowed', 'No kennels'), and a 2022 Campendium reviewer: 'This campground looks like a workers camp'. For nightly use: the same reviewer: 'At the entry there is a self pay board and a lock box ... Site 11(ours) and 40 were designated overnight stay only'; another (2022) 'Self Pay, Put Your $25. Cash In Envelope'; all 5 RV Life reviews are one-night stops in 2026. Test 2: no nightly price posted by the operator and no booking engine; if AWH treats it as long-stay in character, that fails test 2. Test 4: at least 2 designated overnight sites of 'about 60' per a reviewer, plus self-pay overnights on other sites, so probably passes, unconfirmed.
PRESENCE: passes (working website with phone; Google open with 189 reviews and phone +1 402-690-4266).
ROAD: reviewers describe about a mile of gravel county road in ('heavy washboard in portions', 'Very dusty gravel road'); fine for a 2WD motorhome by every account.
Note: left unchanged (its facts are still true); laundry and showers are stated only in the note and on no operator page.
